bull.reason: AI capex supercycle: hyperscalers (MSFT, GOOG, AMZN, META) ramping GPU spending 30–50% YoY. H100/H200 demand outpacing supply. Data center revenue growth 40%+ sustainable through 2027. TAM expansion in inference, autonomous vehicles, enterprise AI.

Market dominance: 80%+ GPU share in data center; high switching costs; software ecosystem (CUDA) entrenched. Gross margins 65%+ sustainable. Operating leverage strong; FCF generation robust. Valuation justified by growth rate vs peers.

Technical setup: stock above 50D/200D MAs; breakout from consolidation. Institutional accumulation evident. Analyst consensus raised; 12-month median target $280–$300. Momentum favors continuation into Q3 2026.

bear.reason: Valuation stretched: 45x forward P/E vs 5-year avg 30x. Stock near 52-week high; limited upside before consolidation. AI capex cycle may peak in 2H26; growth deceleration risk. Multiple compression likely if macro weakens or earnings miss.

Geopolitical/export control risk: China ban reduces TAM by ~15–20%. Taiwan fab concentration (TSMC) creates supply chain vulnerability. US–China tensions could escalate; new restrictions possible. Regulatory uncertainty weighs on long-term guidance.

Competition intensifying: AMD gaining share in MI300 series; Intel Arc ramping. Hyperscalers developing custom chips (TPU, Trainium). Gross margin pressure possible if competition forces price cuts. Customer concentration (top 3 = 50%+ revenue) adds risk.
